schema.label: 边缘亮线宽度
schema.description: 窄核的 1/e 半宽；约 0.57 CSS px / 520px 高。窄核权重 5%，为拟合估值。
schema.descriptionEn: Narrow-core 1/e half-width: about 0.57 CSS px at 520px height. Its 5% weight is a reconstruction estimate.

schema.label: 向内发散宽度
schema.description: 内侧高斯 1/e 半宽；约 2.73 CSS px / 520px 高。原图半峰约 8px，10% 约 14–18px。
schema.descriptionEn: Inward Gaussian 1/e half-width: about 2.73 CSS px at 520px height. Source half strength is about 8px, and 10% at 14–18px.

schema.label: 外侧余光宽度
schema.description: 外侧弱光的 1/e 半宽，独立于内侧发散；4px 为保守拟合估值。
schema.descriptionEn: Outer-glow 1/e half-width, independent of inward diffusion. The 4px default is a conservative reconstruction estimate.

schema.label: 外侧余光强度
schema.description: 外侧最高透明度；默认 4%，避免将应用边缘变成宽霓虹描边。
schema.descriptionEn: Maximum outer opacity: 4% by default, keeping the edge from becoming a broad neon outline.

schema.label: 边缘光整体强度
schema.description: 统一缩放亮线、内侧发散和外侧余光的透明度。
schema.descriptionEn: Scales the opacity of the narrow core, inward diffusion and outer glow together.

schema.label: 边缘色彩播放倍率
schema.description: 沿 0–12 秒采样播放；随后用 1 秒衔接回起点，循环衔接为复刻处理。
schema.descriptionEn: Plays the 0–12s samples, then blends back to the start over 1s. This loop transition is a reconstruction choice.
